name: manuelbiolatiri/pass-mcp
description: Issue, delegate, and manage Apple Wallet (.pkpass) and Google Wallet passes under signed RFC 8693 delegation mandates with 100 free daily passes.

tools.name: issue_mandate
tools.description: Issue a signed RFC 8693 delegation mandate token for an AI agent.

tools.name: request_pass
tools.description: Request an Apple Wallet (.pkpass) or Google Wallet pass under a delegation token.

tools.name: get_holder_passes
tools.description: Get all active Apple & Google Wallet passes held by a human principal.

tools.name: lookup_pass
tools.description: Lookup full details of a specific pass by passId or serialNumber.

tools.name: check_mandate_status
tools.description: Check live status and remaining lifetime of a delegation token.

tools.name: poll_escalation
tools.description: Poll status of a pending CIBA human-in-the-loop escalation request.
